In the statement of changes in equity, reducing retained earnings. They are not an expense.

front: Final dividend and the year end
back: Declared before the year end and unpaid: a current liability. Recommended after the year end: a note only.

front: Effect of a transfer to the general reserve
back: Retained earnings fall and the general reserve rises by the same amount; total equity and cash do not change.
Issued share capital + share premium + other capital reserves + revenue reserves + retained earnings.
A share with a fixed rate of dividend paid before any ordinary dividend; cumulative preference shares carry forward unpaid dividends.

front: Why are unrealised gains not distributable?
back: The gain exists only on paper; paying it out would return capital to the owners and harm the creditors.
